text:
maya: quick async standup — what I did: prewarmed 6 spot GPUs in AMS, pushed autoscale tweak to use burst pool when queue > 120. blocked by: AMS quota bump still pending, saw 2 failed fallback routings to FRA last night. today: open a cloud support ticket, can someone eyeball CR#3124 (autoscale policy change)?

sam: saw the failed fallbacks too. looked like route table mismatch for FRA -> fallback-pool. i can take CR#3124 review in ~1h. FYI i restarted the region-routing service at 03:12 UTC and metrics smoothed out.

jordan: the quota request is still in review with cloud. asked account manager for escalation this morning. linking request id: REQ-8841. if we need emergency capacity, we can flip to reserved instances but that's manual.

lee: ran `./scripts/check-az-capacity --region=ams` — output: "available_gpus: 14, requested: 128, quota: 160". looks ok but usage spike pushed us close to soft limits. posted the small log below:
```
2026-03-17T02:58:04Z region=ams available=14 requested=118 queued=6
2026-03-17T03:10:22Z region=ams available=8 requested=126 queued=12
```
planning to run the prewarm job at 04:00 UTC.

pat: if quota bump doesn't land, propose enabling FRA fallback permanently for next 24h and set scaling floor to +2 nodes in AMS. someone needs to approve the cost delta (~$700/day) — @maya can you greenlight if needed? :eyes:

maya: @pat ok to approve emergency for 24h if cloud doesn't approve by 10:00 UTC. i'll also ping finance to log the spike. :+1:

quota-bot: automated quota report — AMS GPUs: 92% of soft quota (147/160), FRA GPUs: 41% (66/160). Quota requests in progress: REQ-8841 (status: in_review).

deploy-bot: notice — autoscale-policy v2.3 deployed to staging at 03:05 UTC by maya. No regressions detected in smoke tests.

jordan: one more thing — can we add a small healthcheck to route-fallbacks to avoid silent failures? i can open a tiny PR. needs a quick design call but it should be trivial: ping route when fallback is chosen and emit metric `fallback.usage` with region tag.

sam: +1 on the metric. that will help ops alerting thresholds. i'll add to the ops runbook after merge.

maya: thanks everyone. action items: sam review CR#3124, jordan PR for fallback healthcheck, maya to escalate REQ-8841 and approve emergency spend if needed, lee to run prewarm at 04:00 and post results here. i'll update thread after cloud reply.

lee: prewarm done at 04:03 UTC — added 6 nodes, `available_gpus` now 20. posting quick check: `./scripts/check-az-capacity --region=ams` -> available=20 queued=2. :seedling:

pat: nice, good recovery.

maya: closing loop — cloud escalated REQ-8841 to high priority at 05:20 UTC. keeping thread open until we get quota bump or until 10:00 UTC cutoff.
